cards.example: Bad eating habits developed in childhood are very hard to change later in life.
A sedentary lifestyle increases the risk of heart disease, so try to move at least an hour a day.
cards.collocation: the dangers of a sedentary lifestyle

cards.example: Childhood obesity has become a serious problem as children eat more sugar and exercise less.
If you want to lose weight, you should reduce your calorie intake and move more.
Processed food often contains hidden salt, sugar and chemicals that can damage your health.
My grandmother always cooks nutritious meals with fresh vegetables from her own garden.
Cycling to school is a great way to burn calories without paying for a gym.
My uncle finally managed to give up smoking after twenty years of trying.
Wholegrain bread contains more fibre than white bread, so it keeps you full for longer.
I try to work out at the gym three times a week after school.
Chronic stress can lead to serious illnesses, such as heart disease and depression.
Doctors recommend that teenagers should do at least sixty minutes of physical activity every day.
Talking openly about mental health encourages young people to ask for help when they feel down.
Exam anxiety can make even well-prepared students forget everything they have learnt.
Sport and meditation help me cope with stress before important exams.
Sleep deprivation affects your memory and mood, so staying up all night before a test is unwise.
Too much screen time before bed makes it harder to fall asleep and get enough rest.
Spending time in nature has a positive effect on both our physical and mental well-being.
Regular exercise and enough sleep strengthen your immune system, so you get ill less often.
The typical symptoms of flu include a high temperature, a sore throat and aching muscles.
It took my grandmother almost three weeks to get over the flu last winter.

My grandfather has to take medication for high blood pressure every morning.
The government should spend more on the prevention of diseases instead of only treating them.
Experts recommend having a medical check-up at least once a year, even if you feel healthy.

My best friend went vegan last year because she is against the cruel treatment of animals.

Edited photos on social media can give teenagers a negative body image.
Instead of trying to go on a diet, it is better to change your eating habits gradually.
Hungary needs to improve public healthcare, because waiting lists for operations are very long.
Some people prefer alternative medicine, such as herbal remedies, to conventional treatment.
Self-care, such as taking regular breaks and sleeping enough, is essential during exam periods.
It is easy to start a new diet, but much harder to stick to it for months.
Smoking is harmful not only to smokers but also to the people around them.
I have a sweet tooth, so it is really hard for me to resist chocolate and cakes.
To lead a healthy lifestyle, you do not need an expensive gym membership, just good habits.
Chocolate and fast food are not dangerous if you eat them in moderation.
There is no doubt that regular exercise improves both your physical and mental health.
